name: Rondo Leaflet
original_name: ロンド・リーフレット
source:
Rondo Leaflet took place in United Kingdom 1892.

Matthew Hamilton is a young servant. As he chose the same job as his father without really caring about it, he has no enthusiasm for service and has been fired five times. The servants' association treats him as a headache, and was about to take his name off the books. To his fortune, he got a final chance: working at a ruined peers' house for free. In fact, that house has very many troubles. Maids are very slack in their work because wages are not paid, the house itself is very dirty, and the landlady doesn't have a very good character as well.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rondo_Leaflet]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在1892年的英国。

马修·汉密尔顿是一名年轻仆役。他并未认真考虑便选择了与父亲相同的职业，因此对侍奉工作毫无热情，已经五次遭到解雇。仆役协会将他视为麻烦人物，正准备把他除名。幸运的是，他得到了最后一次机会：前往一个衰败的贵族家庭无偿工作。事实上，那座宅邸问题重重。女仆们因拿不到薪水而消极怠工，宅邸本身肮脏不堪，女主人性格也很糟糕。

[编辑自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rondo_Leaflet]Wikipedia[/url]]
